description: Implemented Message Expiry subset for retained and nonretained QoS0/1/2 inputs and QoS0/1 outputs. Descriptive system evidence; the historical fixture oracle does not qualify expiry, retained replay, transmission start or temporal quarantine.
authority: The adapter supplies bounded clock observations; the pure owner preserves exact recipes and frame/claim identities; the durable writer owns atomic mutation and cleanup; only positive socket bytes can establish transmission start. Timers and queued effects grant no delivery or credit authority.
limitations: Unknown or unrecognized restart continuity quarantines old expiring values and unsent work, retaining bounded references. This sacrifices availability and does not claim strict cross-restart lifetime compliance in that environment.
A recovered claim without durable Started may already have sent bytes. After established freshness is lost it is quarantined; claim existence never proves transmission or certain nontransmission.
Outgoing QoS2, Will, migration, universal clock continuity, performance and power-loss claims remain outside this subset. Product, model and historical oracle evidence retain their separate scopes.

rules.guard: Absent property means no lifetime. Present u32 is finite, including0 and0xffffffff; reception fixes domain/tick before input deferral and checked deadline arithmetic.
One admissible frozen observation selects only established-fresh retained versions. Each replay inherits the original expiry, payload and version.
An expiring value and current reading have different domains. No elapsed time or renewed origin can be established.
Before every zero-progress write attempt, matching nonregressed time establishes freshness. Patch remaining seconds rounded upward inside the original interval.
A positive-byte observation matches the exact frame, connection and claim. The frame now completes or closes; a separately guarded writer operation records Started.
Known Started retains payload, Packet Identifier and exact claim through PUBACK and known Finish. Replay after expiry carries remaining zero.
This exact frame certainly wrote no bytes and no earlier attempt remains uncertain. Established expiry and exact claim guards authorize one normal durable ExpireDelivery operation.

One writer request visits at most four publication keys, returns absolute removed identities, and advances only a received live cursor. Remove retained and unclaimed expired references; preserve inbound QoS2 and every outbound claim.
One maintenance reply is deliberately dropped after a real SQLite transaction. The retry keeps the same domain/tick and key cursor; no OperationId or historical cursor row is created.
